name: CoverCraft
description: AI-powered Chrome extension for cover letters, tailored resumes, and follow-up questions

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; frame-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://openrouter.ai https://api.groq.com https://api.tavily.com https://app.tavily.com https://firestore.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com;
content_security_policy.sandbox: sandbox allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-modals; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; child-src 'self';
